dict.string: Merlin reads the address of your browser's current tab when you ask it to summarize the video you're watching.
Merlin transcribes a video's audio on your Mac so Claude can summarize it.
Merlin adds the events you ask for (like "add dinner to my calendar at 7") to your calendar, and can undo them.
Merlin adds the events you ask for to your calendar.

Merlin listens while you hold its talk shortcut, turning your voice into text so you can ask questions and add calendar events by speaking. With the Groq Whisper voice engine on, the audio goes to Groq.
Merlin keeps the screenshots that macOS saves on your Desktop, and reads a file there when you ask about it.
Merlin reads a file in your Downloads folder when you ask about it.
Merlin reads your documents and textbooks when you ask it to, and saves your notes in Documents/Merlin Notes.
